examples.chinese: 你往前走，過第二個十字路口，就到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, guò dì èr ge shízì lùkǒu, jiù dào le.
examples.english: Go straight ahead, pass the second intersection, and you'll arrive.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 這個路口很危險，經常發生車禍。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lùkǒu hěn wēixiǎn, jīngcháng fāshēng chēhuò.
examples.english: This intersection is very dangerous; car accidents often happen here.

examples.chinese: 我看見路口有人舉著一面牌子，上面是銷售房屋的廣告。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn lùkǒu yǒu rén jǔ zhe yī miàn páizi, shàngmiàn shì xiāoshòu fángwū de guǎnggào.
examples.english: I saw someone at the intersection holding up a sign, on which was an advertisement for selling houses.

items.wordHook: 路口 means crossroad: 路(road) + 口(mouth) → the mouth of the road where it opens into an intersection.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我剛去工作的時候，常常需要同事的幫助。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"幫助別人讓我覺得很快樂！","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng qù gōngzuò de shíhou, chángcháng xūyào tóngshì de bāngzhù. Bāngzhù biérén ràng wǒ juéde hěn kuàilè!
examples.english: When I first started working, I often needed my colleagues' help. Helping others makes me feel very happy!

examples.chinese: 我們都是好同學，應該互相幫助、互相學習。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu shì hǎo tóngxué, yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù, hùxiāng xuéxí.
examples.english: We are all good classmates; we should help each other and learn from each other.

examples.chinese: 護理師的工作就是幫助醫生處理病人的問題。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī de gōngzuò jiùshì bāngzhù yīshēng chǔlǐ bìngrén de wèntí.
examples.english: A nurse's job is to help doctors deal with patients' problems.

examples.chinese: 像慢跑、游泳那樣的運動，對健康極有幫助。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng mànpǎo, yóuyǒng nàyàng de yùndòng, duì jiànkāng jí yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.english: Sports like jogging and swimming are extremely helpful for health.

examples.chinese: 利用週末到安養院幫助老人，是很有意義的活動。
examples.pinyin: Lìyòng zhōumò dào ānyǎngyuàn bāngzhù lǎorén, shì hěn yǒu yìyì de huódòng.
examples.english: Using the weekend to go to a nursing home to help the elderly is a very meaningful activity.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我喜歡週末跟家人聚在一起吃飯、聊天。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"愛心服務社把社員的愛心聚在一起，到安養院去幫助老人。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yīqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwùshè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yīqǐ, dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.chinese: 莫以凡寫了一張卡片，感謝台灣朋友對他的幫助。
examples.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, gǎnxiè Táiwān péngyǒu duì tā de bāngzhù.
examples.english: Mo Yifan wrote a card to thank his Taiwanese friends for their help.

examples.chinese: 許多大學生參加愛心服務的社團，幫助老人打掃環境。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng cānjiā àixīn fúwù de shètuán, bāngzhù lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng.
examples.english: Many university students join volunteer service clubs to help the elderly clean up the environment.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，幸福就是在身邊有一群願意互相幫助的好友。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, xìngfú jiùshì zài shēnbiān yǒu yī qún yuànyì hùxiāng bāngzhù de hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: To me, happiness is having a group of good friends around who are willing to help each other.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

examples.chinese: 我覺得跳舞這項活動對健康很有幫助，還可以交到很多朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tiàowǔ zhè xiàng huódòng duì jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù, hái kěyǐ jiāo dào hěn duō péngyǒu.
examples.english: I think the activity of dancing is very helpful for health, and you can also make many friends.

examples.chinese: 所謂「人助天助」的意思，就是得自己先努力，天(God,Heavens)才會幫助你。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi “rén zhù tiān zhù” de yìsi, jiù shì děi zìjǐ xiān nǔlì, tiān cái huì bāngzhù nǐ.
examples.english: The so-called meaning of 'people help, Heaven helps' is that you must first work hard yourself, and only then will Heaven help you.

examples.chinese: 看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn yǒu kùnnán de rénmen, yǒu nénglì de huà jiù děi xiǎng bànfǎ bāngzhù tāmen, bù yīnggāi bù lǐ tāmen.
examples.english: When you see people in difficulty, if you are able, you should think of ways to help them; you shouldn't pay no attention to them.

examples.chinese: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dānxīn yíngyǎng bù gòu de huà, chī diǎnr wéitāmìng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng huì yǒu bāngzhù de.
examples.english: If you're worried about not getting enough nutrition, taking some vitamins will help your health.

examples.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
examples.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

examples.chinese: 我週末都去育幼院照顧沒有父母的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò dōu qù yùyòuyuàn zhàogù méiyǒu fùmǔ de háizi.
examples.english: On weekends I go to the orphanage to take care of children without parents.

examples.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuésheng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
examples.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

examples.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuésheng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
examples.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

examples.chinese: 媽媽今天要加班，我得照顧妹妹，不能不早一點兒回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma jīntiān yào jiābān, wǒ děi zhàogù mèimei, bùnéngbù zǎo yīdiǎnr huí jiā.
examples.english: Mom has to work overtime today, and I have to take care of my little sister, so I cannot but go home a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
examples.pinyin: Línjū yǒu jíshì děi chūmén chǔlǐ, qǐng wǒ zànshí bāng tā zhàogù háizi.
examples.english: My neighbor had an urgent matter to go out and handle, so she asked me to temporarily help take care of her child.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 從小我父母就去世了，一直是我大哥、大嫂在照顧我的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo wǒ fùmǔ jiù qùshì le, yīzhí shì wǒ dàgē, dàsǎo zài zhàogù wǒ de.
examples.english: My parents passed away when I was little; it has always been my eldest brother and sister-in-law who have been taking care of me.

examples.chinese: 想把菜園照顧好，平時就得多用心，看到蟲子就得處理。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng bǎ càiyuán zhàogù hǎo, píngshí jiù děi duō yòngxīn, kàndào chóngzi jiù děi chǔlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to take good care of the vegetable garden, you must be more attentive in daily life; when you see bugs, you must deal with them.

examples.chinese: 在照顧及教育孩子上，父母都具有相同的法律義務。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhàogù jí jiàoyù háizi shàng, fùmǔ dōu jùyǒu xiāngtóng de fǎlǜ yìwù.
examples.english: In caring for and educating children, both parents have the same legal obligation.

examples.chinese: 他放下工作回家鄉的理由，是因為家裡的農場無人照顧。
examples.pinyin: Tā fàngxià gōngzuò huí jiāxiāng de lǐyóu, shì yīnwèi jiā lǐ de nóngchǎng wú rén zhàogù.
examples.english: The reason he gave up his job and returned to his hometown is that no one was taking care of the family farm.

examples.chinese: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Fāng zhùyuàn kāidāo shí, tóngshìmen dōu lúnliú dào yīyuàn wèiwèn bìng zhàogù tā.
examples.english: When Old Fang was hospitalized for surgery, his colleagues all took turns going to the hospital to comfort and take care of him.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽退休後，就在家幫忙照顧孫子和孫女。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma tuìxiū hòu, jiù zài jiā bāngmáng zhàogù sūnzi hé sūnnǚ.
examples.english: After my mother retired, she helps take care of her grandson and granddaughter at home.

examples.chinese: 要保持古文物原來的樣子不容易，需要好好照顧。
examples.pinyin: Yào bǎochí gǔ wénwù yuánlái de yàngzi bù róngyì, xūyào hǎohǎo zhàogù.
examples.english: It is not easy to keep ancient cultural artifacts in their original condition; they need to be well taken care of.

examples.chinese: 臺北美術館最近舉辦了很有名的畫展，吸引了很多民眾去欣賞那些畫。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Měishùguǎn zuìjìn jǔbàn le hěn yǒumíng de huàzhǎn, xīyǐn le hěn duō mínzhòng qù xīnshǎng nàxiē huà.
examples.english: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum recently held a very famous painting exhibition, attracting many people to go appreciate those paintings.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 這位著名畫家的作品，目前正在美術館展出。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng huàjiā de zuòpǐn, mùqián zhèngzài měishùguǎn zhǎnchū.
examples.english: This famous painter's works are currently on display at the art museum.

examples.chinese: 那個店員只顧著玩手機，客人來了都不知道。
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán zhǐ gùzhe wán shǒujī, kèrén lái le dōu bù zhīdào.
examples.english: That clerk only cared about playing on his phone; he didn't even notice when customers came.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 這家超市賣的商品都是安全的，讓顧客買得安心、吃得安心，用的也安心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì mài de shāngpǐn dōu shì ānquán de, ràng gùkè mǎi de ānxīn, chī de ānxīn, yòng de yě ānxīn.
examples.english: The products sold at this supermarket are all safe, allowing customers to buy with peace of mind, eat with peace of mind, and use with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

examples.chinese: 媽媽今天要加班，我得照顧妹妹，不能不早一點兒回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma jīntiān yào jiābān, wǒ děi zhàogù mèimei, bùnéngbù zǎo yīdiǎnr huí jiā.
examples.english: Mom has to work overtime today, and I have to take care of my little sister, so I cannot but go home a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important.

examples.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuésheng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
examples.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

examples.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuésheng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
examples.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

examples.chinese: 筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

examples.chinese: 我週末都去育幼院照顧沒有父母的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò dōu qù yùyòuyuàn zhàogù méiyǒu fùmǔ de háizi.
examples.english: On weekends I go to the orphanage to take care of children without parents.

examples.chinese: 鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
examples.pinyin: Línjū yǒu jíshì děi chūmén chǔlǐ, qǐng wǒ zànshí bāng tā zhàogù háizi.
examples.english: My neighbor had an urgent matter to go out and handle, so she asked me to temporarily help take care of her child.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 從小我父母就去世了，一直是我大哥、大嫂在照顧我的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo wǒ fùmǔ jiù qùshì le, yīzhí shì wǒ dàgē, dàsǎo zài zhàogù wǒ de.
examples.english: My parents passed away when I was little; it has always been my eldest brother and sister-in-law who have been taking care of me.

examples.chinese: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shūdiàn gòumǎi shāngpǐn, gùkè děi xiān huìkuǎn. Yībān gòuwù wǎngzhàn dōu shì děng shōudào gùkè de huìkuǎn hòu, cái jìchū shāngpǐn de.
examples.english: To purchase products at this online bookstore, customers must first remit money. Generally, shopping websites all wait until they have received the customer's remittance before they send out the products.

examples.chinese: 購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù wǎngzhàn huì bǎ chángjiàn de gòuwù wèntí jí chǔlǐ fāngshì fàng zài wǎngyè shàng, tígōng gěi gùkè cānkǎo.
examples.english: Shopping websites will put commonly seen shopping problems and how to handle them on their web pages, providing them for customers' reference.

examples.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí, zhùmíng diǎnxīn diàn dōu huì shōudào dàliàng de dìngdān, shènzhì yǒu gùkè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìngdān le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year, famous pastry shops receive a large number of orders; some customers even place orders half a year in advance.

examples.chinese: 顧客付了錢，賣家也交了貨，這樣子交易才算完成。
examples.pinyin: Gùkè fù le qián, màijiā yě jiāo le huò, zhèyàngzi jiāoyì cái suàn wánchéng.
examples.english: The customer has paid, and the seller has delivered the goods; only then is the transaction considered complete.

examples.chinese: 想把菜園照顧好，平時就得多用心，看到蟲子就得處理。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng bǎ càiyuán zhàogù hǎo, píngshí jiù děi duō yòngxīn, kàndào chóngzi jiù děi chǔlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to take good care of the vegetable garden, you must be more attentive in daily life; when you see bugs, you must deal with them.

examples.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
examples.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 在照顧及教育孩子上，父母都具有相同的法律義務。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhàogù jí jiàoyù háizi shàng, fùmǔ dōu jùyǒu xiāngtóng de fǎlǜ yìwù.
examples.english: In caring for and educating children, both parents have the same legal obligation.

examples.chinese: 在處理那位顧客的問題上，餐廳的態度真令我失望。
examples.pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ nà wèi gùkè de wèntí shàng, cāntīng de tàidù zhēn lìng wǒ shīwàng.
examples.english: In handling that customer's problem, the restaurant's attitude really disappointed me.

examples.chinese: 他放下工作回家鄉的理由，是因為家裡的農場無人照顧。
examples.pinyin: Tā fàngxià gōngzuò huí jiāxiāng de lǐyóu, shì yīnwèi jiā lǐ de nóngchǎng wú rén zhàogù.
examples.english: The reason he gave up his job and returned to his hometown is that no one was taking care of the family farm.

examples.chinese: 對顧客來說，品牌代表了對公司服務的印象以及商品的品質。
examples.pinyin: Duì gùkè lái shuō, pǐnpái dàibiǎo le duì gōngsī fúwù de yìnxiàng yǐjí shāngpǐn de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: For customers, a brand represents the impression of the company's service as well as the quality of the product.

examples.chinese: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn shícháng zài guòjié shí jǔbàn jiàngjià huódòng lái xīyǐn gùkè.
examples.english: Online stores often hold discount events during festivals to attract customers.

examples.chinese: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Fāng zhùyuàn kāidāo shí, tóngshìmen dōu lúnliú dào yīyuàn wèiwèn bìng zhàogù tā.
examples.english: When Old Fang was hospitalized for surgery, his colleagues all took turns going to the hospital to comfort and take care of him.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽退休後，就在家幫忙照顧孫子和孫女。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma tuìxiū hòu, jiù zài jiā bāngmáng zhàogù sūnzi hé sūnnǚ.
examples.english: After my mother retired, she helps take care of her grandson and granddaughter at home.

examples.chinese: 要保持古文物原來的樣子不容易，需要好好照顧。
examples.pinyin: Yào bǎochí gǔ wénwù yuánlái de yàngzi bù róngyì, xūyào hǎohǎo zhàogù.
examples.english: It is not easy to keep ancient cultural artifacts in their original condition; they need to be well taken care of.

examples.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
examples.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

items.wordHook: Before offering 雇(employment) to an applicant, turn your 頁(head) to carefully 顧(take into account) their qualifications.

examples.chinese: 以前我的小學老師總是親切地教導我們，讓我到現在還是很懷念她。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ de xiǎoxué lǎoshī zǒngshì qīnqiè de jiàodǎo wǒmen, ràng wǒ dào xiànzài háishì hěn huáiniàn tā.
examples.english: My elementary school teacher used to teach us kindly, which makes me still cherish her memory even now.

examples.chinese: 小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu zhǎodào lǐxiǎng gōngzuò hòu, nǚyǒu tèdì sòng le yī tiáo lǐngdài dāngzuò lǐwù, hái qīnshǒu wèi tā dǎ lǐngdài, zhùhè tā yǒu gè hǎo de kāishǐ.
examples.english: After Xiao Zhou found his ideal job, his girlfriend specially gave him a necktie as a gift, and even personally tied the necktie for him, congratulating him on a good start.

examples.chinese: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn biérén shìyè hěn chénggōng, chúle xiànmù yǐwài, gèng yào xuéxí tā de yōudiǎn.
examples.english: When you see others being very successful in their careers, besides envying them, you should also learn from their strengths.

examples.chinese: 別看超人那麼受歡迎就羨慕他，其實能力越強，身上的責任也越重。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Chāorén nàme shòu huānyíng jiù xiànmù tā, qíshí nénglì yuè qiáng, shēnshang de zérèn yě yuè zhòng.
examples.english: Don't envy Superman just because he's so popular; actually, the stronger your abilities, the heavier your responsibilities.

examples.chinese: 他與妻子雖然已結婚多年，感情仍維持得很好，真令人羨慕。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǔ qīzi suīrán yǐ jiéhūn duō nián, gǎnqíng réng wéichí de hěn hǎo, zhēn lìng rén xiànmù.
examples.english: Although he and his wife have been married for many years, their affection is still maintained very well; it truly makes people envious.

examples.chinese: 在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu guójiā, zhǐyào rénmín juéde bù hélǐ, dōu néng gēn xiāngguān bùmén kàngyì.
examples.english: In a free country, as long as people feel something is unreasonable, they can protest to the relevant departments.

examples.chinese: 在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
examples.pinyin: Zài kàngyì xīn jiàn gōngchǎng de huódòng zhōng, dāngdì de huánbǎo tuántǐ liánhé qǐlái biǎodá tāmen de xūqiú.
examples.english: In the protest against the construction of a new factory, local environmental groups united to express their demands.

items.wordHook: A 亠(lid) clamps down on the rich 土(soil) you cultivate, marking the land as property you own → 主(own).
A 亥(covered person) is carved by a 刂(knife) — the blade cuts the shape into the surface, so 刻 means carve.
Combining 民(citizens) and 眾(multitude): 民眾 means people, populace.
